blocks.text: Chilliwack 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos Market Guide

parts.t: Active MLS® listings of age-restricted condos (55+ and 45+) in Chilliwack, BC are all shown on this page, and the local sub-areas are compared below.
Sardis East Vedder
Sardis East Vedder: older family streets east of Vedder Road, a short way from shops, parks and Sardis Secondary.
Sardis West Vedder
Sardis West Vedder: gated adult complexes sit west of Vedder Road alongside quiet cul-de-sacs, not far from the Vedder River trails.
Downtown Chilliwack (District 1881)
Downtown Chilliwack (District 1881): the downtown core including District 1881, home to most of the city's new mid-rise condo construction.
Vedder Crossing
Vedder Crossing: south-side commercial hub with condos and townhomes near the Vedder River.
Chilliwack Proper West
Chilliwack Proper West: condos and townhomes at the entry level, close to Highway 1 and Luckakuck/Young Road.
Garrison Crossing
Garrison Crossing: the old CFB Chilliwack base has become a walkable village with condos, townhomes and heritage-style homes.

The BC Strata Property Act governs strata title for 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos. Prior to removing subjects, obtain the depreciation report, Form B, the strata minutes from the last two years and the bylaws, including those on age restrictions, pets and rentals. In these complexes the age bylaws must be met by at least one occupant.

Floodplain: lower Sardis, along with parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale and Yarrow, is in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain; the City's dike network is what protects these areas. For any property, ask about its flood construction level, the requirements of lenders and insurers, and whether title has a geotechnical or floodplain covenant registered.

Schools and transit: Chilliwack falls under School District 33 (SD33). Its schools include Chilliwack Secondary, Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, plus elementary catchments such as Vedder, Watson and Unsworth. Check catchment with SD33 before buying. Locally, BC Transit routes run along Young Road, Vedder Road and Luckakuck Way. Beyond the city, Route 66, the Fraser Valley Express, connects Chilliwack with Abbotsford and Carvolth Exchange in Langley.

Where are 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos for sale in Chilliwack usually located?

These 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos concentrate in Garrison Crossing, Chilliwack Proper West, Vedder Crossing, Downtown Chilliwack (District 1881), Sardis West Vedder and Sardis East Vedder. The mix of age, lot size and price is different in every area, so choose two or three neighbourhoods to focus on first, then arrange showings.
How often do these Chilliwack 55+ condo listings update?
Listings on this page update directly from the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® feed several times a day, so new listings, price changes and sold statuses appear quickly.
Before buying a 55+ condo in Chilliwack, what should be checked about zoning, strata or ALR?

Because 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos are strata title, the BC Strata Property Act applies. Ahead of removing subjects, ask for Form B, the depreciation report, the bylaws on rentals, pets and age restrictions, and the previous two years of strata minutes. These complexes enforce their age bylaws against at least one occupant.
Are any Chilliwack 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos in the floodplain?

Several areas, among them Greendale, Fairfield Island, Yarrow, Rosedale and lower Sardis, lie within the Fraser and Vedder Rivers floodplain and rely on the City's dike network for protection. Ask about the flood construction level, what the lender and insurer will need, and any geotechnical or floodplain covenant registered on title.
Which schools serve Chilliwack 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos?

SD33, or School District 33, is Chilliwack's district. For Sardis and the south side, the schools are Sardis Secondary and G.W. Graham, and the north side goes to Chilliwack Secondary. As catchments can change, SD33 can confirm the school for any given address.
Is public transit available near Chilliwack 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos?

Yes. BC Transit operates local routes in Chilliwack on Vedder Road, Young Road and Luckakuck Way, and the Fraser Valley Express provides a link to Abbotsford and Langley. Don't count on a bus in rural areas, where Ryder Lake, Greendale and Columbia Valley see little or no service.
